chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام about a newborn whose head was not shaved on the seventh day, so he said:
“If seven days have passed, then there is no shaving required of him.”
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a newborn’s head was not shaved on the seventh day?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding shaving the head of a newborn on the seventh day. It indicates that if the seventh day passes without the head being shaved, the act is no longer required afterward.
